title:
CASE STUDY: Just bought.
*Just lost your job*

lines.say: You just bought a 1.8 million dollar resale condo. Now you've lost your job.
Your loan is about 4,700 dollars a month. What do you do first?
Don't rush to sell. In year one, Seller's Stamp Duty is 16%. That's about 288,000 dollars.

count.label: SSD if you sell in year one

lines.say: Step one: call your bank before you miss a payment. A missed payment can show up on your credit report.
Step two: check your CPF Ordinary Account. It can pay the monthly loan. 30,000 dollars covers about six months.
Step three: if it's still tight, rent out the whole unit and move somewhere cheaper until you're back on your feet.
The lesson: before you buy, set aside six months of instalments. Here, about 28,000 dollars.
Not sure if you're on track? Comment check.

source: MOF, CPF Board, bank rates Oct 2026
caption:
You just bought a $1.8M resale condo. Then you lost your job. What now? 🏙️

Your loan is about $4,700 a month, and selling in year one means 16% Seller's Stamp Duty, about $288K. So don't rush to sell.

1. Call your bank before you miss a payment.
2. Check your CPF Ordinary Account. It can pay the monthly loan while you find work.
3. If it's still tight, rent out the unit and move somewhere cheaper for now.

The lesson: set aside six months of instalments before you sign.

Not sure if you're on track? Comment CHECK 👇

Illustration only. Loan at about 1.5% over 30 years. Your bank's terms may differ.
